title: Diagnose and fix deployment error preventing successful build

requirements.summary: Investigate and identify the specific build or deployment error preventing Draft Version 20 from deploying successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Build logs are reviewed to identify the exact error message and stack trace
The root cause of the deployment failure is identified (backend compilation error, frontend build error, or deployment configuration issue)
Error is documented with specific file paths and line numbers if applicable

file_operations.description: Review and fix any TypeScript compilation errors, import issues, or React component syntax problems that may be causing build failures. Verify all component imports are correct and routing configuration is valid.
Review all React Query hooks to ensure they correctly reference backend methods from the backend interface and have proper error handling. Verify no undefined method calls exist.
Review provider setup, import statements, and ensure no circular dependencies or module resolution issues exist that could prevent successful build.

requirements.summary: Fix any TypeScript or React compilation errors in frontend source files that are preventing successful frontend build
acceptanceCriteria: All TypeScript type errors are resolved
Import statements and module paths are correct
React component syntax errors are fixed
Frontend builds successfully without errors
All existing components render without runtime errors

file_operations.description: Fix any TypeScript type errors, incorrect prop passing, or missing import statements. Ensure all hooks and components are properly typed and imported.
Resolve TypeScript compilation errors related to message types, chat functionality, and component props. Verify all enums and types match the backend interface.
Fix type mismatches in file upload handling, ExternalBlob usage, and tab component integration. Ensure proper typing for all state variables and props.
Resolve type errors in profile updates, family member management, and account deletion flows. Ensure Principal types are correctly used throughout.
Fix type errors related to Location interface, geolocation API integration, and family member location display.
Resolve ExternalBlob type usage errors, file upload progress handling, and media item display TypeScript issues.
Fix any type errors in reminder creation, date handling, and status badge logic.
Resolve TypeScript errors in drag functionality, message sending, and chat state management. Ensure proper typing for all event handlers.
Fix type errors in form handling, expense category enum usage, and mutation hook integration.
Resolve type mismatches in expense data visualization and chart rendering logic.
Fix TypeScript errors in expense calculation logic and insight generation.
Resolve type errors in permission request form handling and submission logic.
Fix type mismatches in permission approval/denial flow and request data handling.
Resolve TypeScript errors in invitation link generation and clipboard functionality.
Fix type errors in navigation, authentication integration, and responsive layout logic.

requirements.summary: Verify that all React Query hooks in useQueries.ts have correct actor method calls and proper error handling
acceptanceCriteria: All mutation and query hooks correctly reference existing backend methods
No undefined method calls or incorrect parameter passing
Error boundaries handle failed queries gracefully
Query invalidation patterns are correct

file_operations.description: Review and correct all query and mutation hooks to ensure they call existing backend methods from the backend interface (frontend/src/backend.d.ts). Verify parameter types match backend signatures, add proper error handling for all queries and mutations, and ensure query invalidation occurs after successful mutations. Fix any undefined method references or type mismatches.

requirements.summary: Ensure all component imports and routing configuration in App.tsx and main.tsx are correctly structured without circular dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: No circular import dependencies exist
All page components are imported correctly
Router configuration has valid paths and elements
AuthProvider and QueryClientProvider are properly configured

file_operations.description: Verify all page component imports are correct and no circular dependencies exist. Ensure TanStack Router configuration has valid route paths and component elements. Confirm ProfileSetupModal and authentication flows are properly wired without import cycles.
Verify provider hierarchy (QueryClientProvider and AuthProvider) is correctly structured. Ensure no circular imports exist in the entry point and all necessary providers are properly configured.
Review actor creation logic to ensure proper typing, error handling, and no circular dependency issues with other hooks or components.
Fix any TypeScript errors in URL parameter extraction and ensure proper typing for hash-based routing utilities used throughout the app.

requirements.summary: Run the complete build and deployment process end-to-end to verify all errors are resolved and the application deploys successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister deploys successfully
Frontend builds and deploys without errors
Application is accessible at the deployment URL
All existing features remain functional after deployment
No console errors appear on initial page load

file_operations.description: After all fixes are applied, verify the App component renders correctly with all routes accessible, authentication flows working, and no console errors on mount.
Verify all query hooks execute successfully without errors after deployment, properly fetching data from the backend and handling edge cases gracefully.
